extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, journalists, researchers, and stakeholders seeking information about the U.S. Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations (PSI)
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the responsibilities, scope, and procedural posture of the U.S. Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, including what it is charged to study and investigate and references to its rules and activity reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility to study and investigate efficiency and economy of operations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations is the Committee’s chief investigative subcommittee and has the responsibility of studying and investigating the efficiency and economy of operations relating to all branches of the government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the stated core charge/scope of PSI — focus is on efficiency and economy across all branches; no additional scoring guidance provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility to study and investigate compliance with rules, regulations, and laws
rubrics_metrics.description: The Subcommittee is also tasked with studying and investigating the compliance or noncompliance with rules, regulations and laws.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page frames compliance investigation as a primary duty; it does not provide procedural detail here but points to the Subcommittee Rules and Rules of Procedure (e.g., 'PSI Rules of Procedure – 119th Congress').

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigate aspects of crime and lawlessness that affect national health, welfare, and safety
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigating all aspects of crime and lawlessness within the United States which have an impact upon or affect the national health, welfare and safety, including syndicated crime, investment fraud schemes, commodity and security fraud, computer fraud, and the use of offshore banking and corporate facilities to carry out criminal objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page enumerates example subject areas (syndicated crime; investment fraud schemes; commodity and security fraud; computer fraud; offshore banking and corporate facilities used for criminal objectives) to clarify investigative focus; no scoring or prioritization guidance is given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operate according to Subcommittee rules and published activities reports
rubrics_metrics.description: References to 'PSI Rules of Procedure – 119th Congress' and multiple 'Activities of the Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations' reports (by Congress sessions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied requirement that investigations and Subcommittee actions follow published rules and procedures and that historic activity reports document past work; the page links to rules and PDFs but does not include their text or specific procedural criteria.
